data.one_liner: WebSocket support for the Dart Frog backend framework.
data.what_it_does: Provides a webSocketHandler to manage WebSocket connections within Dart Frog route handlers. It allows streaming messages from clients and sending outgoing messages back via a channel sink.
use_when: You are building a backend using Dart Frog and need WebSocket support
You need to handle real-time, bi-directional communication between clients and a Dart Frog server
avoid_when: You are not using the Dart Frog backend framework
You only need standard HTTP REST endpoints without persistent connections
strengths: Seamlessly integrates with Dart Frog routing and handlers
Straightforward API using standard channel stream and sink patterns
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Dart Frog framework
Limited documentation outside of basic examples
data.setup_notes: Add dart_frog_web_socket to dependencies and use webSocketHandler in route handlers.

alternatives.name: shelf_web_socket
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using Shelf directly rather than the Dart Frog framework wrapper.
